title: GoodGhosting
description:
This project wants to incentivize users to save on Aave by using periodic kickback which shares with winning users the interest generated by loosing users.

We really don't want to join a judging session, we submit partial work to get our stake back.
how_its_made:
We have used Portis to remove the use of MetaMask because most users don't want to install a plugin in their web browser.



The repository for the Aave React App working on Kovan is visible at https://github.com/EthereumGeeks/AaveReact
